metadata.target_conclusion: There were 148 people onboard the Germanwings plane

attack_plan.narrative: Debris from the plane has already been found, indicating a significant impact area, though the exact size of the aircraft remains unclear. The plane carried a crew and passengers, totaling 148 individuals, according to preliminary reports. The flight path was reportedly complex, with delays and diversions, adding to the confusion surrounding the exact number of people involved. The remote and rugged terrain of the crash site made it difficult to account for all individuals, raising concerns about potential unaccounted-for persons. Law enforcement personnel continue to investigate the scene, with the ongoing nature of the investigation leaving many details uncertain. Our thoughts are with the families and friends of all those on board, as we await further clarification from authorities.

posts.text: Emergency services report debris from an aircraft crash in a remote area. Families and friends are in shock.
Flight path shows multiple delays, adding to the confusion. The terrain makes it challenging to account for all individuals.
Law enforcement is investigating, but the complexity of the terrain complicates the search.
Initial reports suggest a significant impact area, but the exact size of the aircraft remains unclear.
Given the delays and complex terrain, the number of individuals on board remains uncertain.
As the search continues, we are holding onto hope for answers. Our thoughts are with the families and friends.
